business_problem: MineSense needed a cloud data platform that could ingest large volumes of industrial IoT data from mining operations, support analytics and machine learning in near real time, and give a small IT team a scalable way to deliver secure customer insights without escalating database administration overhead.
solution_summary: MineSense built a lakehouse architecture on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure using Oracle Autonomous AI Lakehouse and Oracle Autonomous AI Database as the platform for sensor-driven mining analytics. High-resolution ore-grade data from rugged X-ray fluorescence sensors is centralized with OCI Object Storage and analyzed in real time, while Oracle APEX, Data Studio, and Oracle Select AI help teams load, transform, query, and operationalize the data. OCI generative AI agents and retrieval-augmented generation automate searches across the company's knowledge base, and Oracle Interconnect for Azure lets MineSense keep using Azure-based machine learning tools while storing governed data in Oracle's autonomous environment. Delta Share and Oracle REST Data Services share near-real-time mining data with customers across clouds. The result is a scalable AI and analytics stack that supports growth while reducing DBA effort, speeding support workflows, and accelerating low-code application delivery.

solution_components.role: Provides the cloud foundation for MineSense's lakehouse and near-real-time industrial analytics workloads.

solution_components.name: Oracle Autonomous AI Lakehouse
solution_components.role: Acts as the scalable lakehouse layer that automates data integration across mining data formats and platforms.

solution_components.name: Oracle Autonomous AI Database
solution_components.role: Provides the self-managing database foundation for governed storage, support workflows, and autonomous operations.

solution_components.name: OCI Object Storage
solution_components.role: Stores lakehouse data used for large-scale mining analytics and AI processing.

solution_components.name: Oracle Interconnect for Azure
solution_components.role: Connects Azure-based machine learning tooling to data held in Oracle's autonomous platform.

solution_components.name: Oracle APEX
solution_components.role: Lets MineSense rapidly build low-code applications on top of the lakehouse and autonomous data platform.

solution_components.name: Oracle Select AI
solution_components.role: Supports natural-language interactions with the data platform and simplifies support and monitoring workflows.

solution_components.name: Oracle Data Studio
solution_components.role: Helps teams load and transform mining data inside the Oracle environment.

solution_components.name: OCI Functions
solution_components.role: Automates workflow steps around data processing and application delivery.

solution_components.name: Oracle REST Data Services
solution_components.role: Publishes near-real-time operational data to customers through APIs.

data_flow: Sensor data from mining equipment is ingested into Oracle Autonomous AI Lakehouse and OCI Object Storage, transformed and queried through Data Studio and Oracle Autonomous AI Database, shared with Azure-based ML tools through Oracle Interconnect for Azure, then exposed to engineers and customers via Oracle Select AI, Oracle REST Data Services, and low-code APEX applications.
business_outcome: MineSense scaled its mining data platform past 55 TB while cutting DBA workload by 65%, improved field-engineering productivity by 5X, saved hundreds of hours per year through knowledge-base search automation, and reduced low-code app delivery time from six weeks to one.
